description: The plot illustrates the loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM with respect to different computation costs. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 2.5, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" with a linear scale, ranging from 1.25 to 2.75, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.25. The plot contains two lines: a blue dashed line representing "Vanilla" and an orange solid line representing "SepLLM". The blue "Vanilla" line starts at approximately (1, 2.6) and ends at around (2.5, 1.9), showing a declining trend. The orange "SepLLM" line starts at about (1, 2.3) and ends at roughly (2.5, 1.7), also exhibiting a declining trend, with both lines consistently decreasing across the x-axis.
